scope: Prospect workflow and proposed shared services; not every legacy module

steps.title: Scoped intake
steps.summary: Single-founder upload with venture, project and meeting purpose.
steps.input: Bearer authentication; 1–12 TXT, MD, text PDF or DOCX files.
steps.output: A scoped job with source records; configured token required.
steps.failure: Reject unsupported, malformed or oversized uploads; retain explicit failure rather than silently OCR.
steps.check: Scope, auth and upload-limit regressions; no multi-user authorization claim.

steps.title: Bounded extraction
steps.summary: Original bytes become source-located text with resource limits.
steps.input: Accepted upload; decoded byte and extraction budgets.
steps.output: Readable passages, stable source IDs and SHA-256 originals.
steps.failure: 15-second outer deadline; parser errors request readable text. Resource limits do not isolate filesystem/network.
steps.check: Parser timeout and extraction tests; macOS host acceptance still needed.

steps.title: Evidence storage
steps.summary: Keep source records, originals, output versions and events in scoped SQLite.
steps.input: Validated intake; authorized scope on retrieval.
steps.output: Transactionally stored job and retrievable original sources.
steps.failure: Reject wrong scope; local persistence still needs operational backup/restore procedure.
steps.check: Store/API tests verify source download and scope.

steps.title: Evidence selection
steps.summary: Default is extractive; model selection requires explicit disclosure opt-in.
steps.input: Stored passages; optional server and request model flags.
steps.output: Exact excerpts at source locators; no independent truth verification.
steps.failure: Reject fabricated citations; preserve conflicting claims for human review.
steps.check: Exact-quote validation; live-model quality remains unvalidated.

steps.title: Brief and confirmation checklist
steps.summary: Produce evidence excerpts and generic confirmation questions.
steps.output: Meeting output and follow-up draft. No selected evidence does not prove the document lacks an answer.
steps.failure: Avoid inferred financing terms, buyer authority or reconciling contradictory sources.
steps.check: Extractive mode takes up to the first 40 passages; this is not complete semantic document review.

steps.title: Browse, edit and inspect
steps.summary: Knowledge & Files browses existing scoped prospect folders, originals and generated views; Prospect Briefs retains editing and review.
steps.input: Saved job and current output version.
steps.output: Reviewed sources and a new version for each draft edit.
steps.failure: Reject stale edits; keep untrusted document text inert.
steps.check: Real API/dashboard desktop/mobile acceptance covers folder search, previews, downloads, history, scope changes and safe navigation to review.

steps.title: Review exact revision
steps.summary: Approve, reject or defer the current artifact version.
steps.output: Recorded review; edit/revert cannot resurrect an old approval.
steps.failure: Stale or conflicting decisions fail; approval grants no external send authority.

steps.title: Authorized external action
steps.summary: No prospect sending endpoint exists; do not turn draft review into permission to send.
steps.input: Proposed recipient, channel, payload version, actor, scope and expiry.
steps.output: Separate scoped grant; idempotent action receipt and confirmed provider result.
steps.failure: Expired grants block; ambiguous delivery reconciles before retry; cancellation cannot undo a completed send.
steps.check: Add adversarial tests for wrong recipient, changed payload, replay and duplicate retries before enabling.

steps.title: Durable execution and shared policy
steps.summary: Prospect persistence does not make every legacy graph durable or all approval stores transactional.
steps.input: Job intent, stable identity, dependencies, action grants and resource budget.
steps.output: Durable checkpoints and explicit job states across restart.
steps.failure: Lease expiry, retry backoff, duplicate prevention, cancellation and unknown-result reconciliation required.
steps.check: Crash/restart and concurrent-worker tests must pass; migrate legacy approvals incrementally.

steps.title: Voice and adaptive interface
steps.summary: Add a conversational surface over the same jobs, evidence and permissions.
steps.input: Authenticated session; selected project; explicit microphone start.
steps.output: Short spoken answer plus evidence, comparison, form or review card from an approved catalog.
steps.failure: Separate stop-speaking from cancel-job; reject stale cards; reconnect to saved work; text fallback.
steps.check: Evaluate Bangla/English, names, numbers, interruption and locked-screen behavior on actual devices.

steps.title: Memory with provenance
steps.summary: Separate assertions, verified facts, preferences, decisions and hypotheses.
steps.input: Source-linked candidate memory with scope, date and sensitivity.
steps.output: Retrievable scoped record with status, supersession and retention rules.
steps.failure: Conflicts remain explicit; stale records flagged; deletion covers derived records and backup policy.
steps.check: Test cross-project leakage, correction propagation and stale business-model retrieval.

steps.title: Isolated workers
steps.summary: Evaluate Boxd as one replaceable execution backend; rv alone is not proven isolation.
steps.input: Minimum task files, explicit egress, scoped credentials, CPU/time/storage budgets.
steps.output: Artifacts, source hashes, execution logs and test receipts.
steps.failure: Destroy or quarantine failed worker; snapshots never undo external side effects.
steps.check: Synthetic denial, credential, timeout, fork, cleanup and recovery tests before customer data.

steps.title: Narrow decision routing
steps.summary: Evaluate rules, existing LLM, Laya and optionally Jev on the same labeled requests.
steps.input: Small relevant text state and finite options including uncertainty.
steps.output: Route suggestion, provider/model version and recorded evaluation.
steps.failure: Abstain or escalate; confidence is not authorization or correctness; no live Jev disclosure without agreement.
steps.check: Held-out English/Bangla/mixed-language data; measure false routing and review burden as well as latency.

steps.title: Release and operational recovery
steps.summary: Tests exist; inherited lint/type/format debt remains. CI deploy steps are placeholders.
steps.input: Exact code and configuration revision, evaluation reports and release scope.
steps.output: Required gates pass, reviewed release, tested backups and recovery procedure.
steps.failure: Preserve failed evidence; diagnose code vs test defect; never weaken a gate solely to pass.
steps.check: Revalidate full CI, real deployment and restore; Harness.io is an optional delivery adapter.

steps.title: Outcome and improvement loop
steps.summary: Map observations to reviewed improvements without generating endless tickets.
steps.input: Task outcomes, corrections, incidents, stale maps and measured review effort.
steps.output: Deduplicated digest or actionable proposal with owner, acceptance, cost and stop condition.
steps.failure: Suppress repetitive alerts; budget the loop; escalate failed evaluations and stop when release criteria pass.
steps.check: Measure useful response time, task accuracy, unsupported claims, recovery, review time and cost; no unattended loop enabled.
